fullPassage: The well-known problem of test anxiety illustrates how emotional arousal can hurt performance. Often students who score poorly on an exam will nonetheless insist that they know the material. Many of them are probably telling the truth. Researchers have found a negative correlation between test-related anxiety and exam performance. That is, students who display high test anxiety tend to score low on exams. Test anxiety can interfere with test taking in several ways, but one critical consideration appears to be the disruption of attention to the test. Many test-anxious students waste too much time worrying about how they're doing and wondering whether others are having similar problems. In addition, there is evidence that test anxiety may deplete one's capacity for self-control, increasing the likelihood of poor performance. In other words, once distracted, test-anxious students might not have the self-control to get themselves back on course.

det.tip: waste time (in) V-ing = ~하는 데 시간을 낭비하다

questions.passage: The well-known problem of test anxiety illustrates how emotional arousal can hurt performance. Often students who score poorly on an exam will nonetheless insist that they know the material. Many of them are probably telling the truth. Researchers have found a negative correlation between test-related anxiety and exam performance. That is, students who display high test anxiety tend to __________. Test anxiety can interfere with test taking in several ways, but one critical consideration appears to be the disruption of attention to the test. Many test-anxious students waste too much time worrying about how they're doing and wondering whether others are having similar problems. In addition, there is evidence that test anxiety may deplete one's capacity for self-control, increasing the likelihood of poor performance. In other words, once distracted, test-anxious students might not have the self-control to get themselves back on course.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: score low on exams(시험에서 낮은 점수를 받다) — 높은 시험 불안의 결과
det.analysis:
❌ ① hurt performance: S1의 감정적 각성이 수행을 해친다는 일반 주장, S5의 구체적 점수 결과와 다름
❌ ② interfere with test taking: S6의 '시험 응시 자체를 방해'라는 다른 층위, tend to 뒤 구체 결과가 아님
✅ ③ score low on exams: 원문 'tend to score low on exams' 그대로
❌ ④ telling the truth: S3의 어휘 활용이지만 'tend to + 동사원형' 문법과 'telling' 형태 불일치
det.tip: students who display high test anxiety tend to __________ → score low on exams

questions.passage: The well-known problem of test anxiety illustrates how emotional arousal can hurt performance. Often students who score poorly on an exam will nonetheless insist that they know the material. Many of them are probably telling the truth. Researchers have found a negative correlation between test-related anxiety and exam performance. That is, students who display high test anxiety tend to score low on exams. Test anxiety can interfere with test taking in several ways, but one critical consideration appears to be the disruption of attention to the test. Many test-anxious students waste too much time worrying about how they're doing and wondering whether others are having similar problems. In addition, there is evidence that test anxiety may deplete one's capacity for self-control, increasing the likelihood of poor performance. In other words, once distracted, test-anxious students might not have the self-control to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: get themselves back on course(다시 궤도에 오르다) — 주의가 흐트러진 후 자기 통제로 회복하는 상태
det.analysis:
✅ ① get themselves back on course: 원문 그대로, 자기 통제로 회복하는 핵심 귀결
❌ ② hurt performance: S1의 구, 자기 통제의 결과 행위와 불일치 (통제가 수행을 해친다는 것은 반대)
❌ ③ interfere with test taking: S6의 구, 자기 통제로 '방해'한다는 것은 의미 반대
❌ ④ know the material: S2의 구, 주의 회복 맥락(S9)과 다른 층위
det.tip: once distracted → might not have the self-control to __________ → get themselves back on course
